content.thinking: The test generator has a bug: restore at i%91==45 can occur before the first save at i%91==90. Let me fix: save first (i%91==0) then restore (i%91==45).

arguments.command: cd /workspace/tests && sed -i "s/        if i % 91 == 90:/        if i % 91 == 0:/; s/            events.append(\['save', 1\])/            events.append(['save', 1])/" wide_borders.py && python3 wide_borders.py
